facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: near hit during cleaning and preparation on LA-7201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on LA-7201 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on LA-7201 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on LA-7201 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically monitoring seal-face condition and temperature. LA-7201 (marine loading arms) is in service for ship loading. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 11 October 2008 a near hit was recorded on LA-7201 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during cleaning and preparation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
